name: 91605 · N Hollywood, CA
findings: ZIP 91605 (N Hollywood) has 109 nonprofit organizations. 40 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 33 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (35% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 91605 (N Hollywood) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 91605 (N Hollywood) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.3 times the typical level).
